lines.en: Six legs take turns gripping the rock.
I climb the stone face upward.
The suckers under me clamp and release.
My claws score shallow marks in the moss.
I sidle across a crack.

lines.zh: 身体压得很低，像贴着墙
lines.en: I keep low, hugging the wall.
Six legs, three pairs, working together.
Damp runs down the stone past me.

lines.zh: 我探了探下一块落脚点
lines.en: I test the next foothold.
My tail curls around a jutting corner.
I move up a foot.
Fine gravel slips from under my claws.
A new heading, sideways.
I breathe shallow so I don't shake loose.
I pause and probe with a feeler.
Water in the crevice. Good.
Stuck to the wall, perfectly still.
All six legs hold tension.
A feeler sweeps the stone.
The scales on my back ease open.
A drop of water hangs from my jaw.
I turn my head to listen inside the rock.
My body sways once.
My suckers reseal.
I'm alone on this wall.
I blink once, slowly.
Wind rises from below.
I draw my tail in a little.
The moss smells faint.
I wait. No rush to descend.
Splayed on six limbs, I'm stable.
A small bug crawls over my back.
I turn on the wall to look at you.

lines.zh: 六条腿里只用了三条撑住
lines.en: Three of my six legs hold me while I look.
You can't reach this high.
I turn my head sideways.

lines.zh: 风把你的味道送上来了
lines.en: The wind carries your scent up.
A feeler reaches toward you.
I'm judging whether you can climb.
I know this rock face well.
No hurry. You can't come up.
I press my body a little flatter.
My gaze stays locked on you.
You may as well wait below.
One of my legs pulls in.
A sucker lets go.
I press myself tighter to the stone.
The scales on my back fall out of line.
That struck my flank.
A soft hiss from me.
I slide half a foot down.
My feelers tremble.
Six legs hunt new holds.
I'll remember this spot.
What is that smell?
I lean half my body off the wall.
The feeler goes first.
Too far. I can't reach.
I shift two steps closer.
Smells like something damp.
My feeler reaches out, then pulls back.

lines.zh: 六条腿不知道该往哪放
lines.en: My six legs don't know where to go.
In the end I pull back.
What's on the wall suits me better.
I watch you from the rock.
Lift it higher.
Then I'll decide.
That's not enough to risk leaving the wall.
Stone and moss are mine.
You keep it.
What you hit was the wall.
I'm above your head.
One of my legs slips.
The suckers catch again.
Gravel rains down on you.
Don't shake this rock face.
I didn't fall. Lucky for you.
I shift to the side.

lines.zh: 我的鳍撑着泥底，慢慢挪。
lines.en: My fins brace the mud as I shift.
That barely touched me.
My kind are on higher walls.

lines.zh: 我往上爬，就是去找它们
lines.en: I climb to find them.
Six legs overlapping is closeness.

lines.zh: 我们一起挂在同一道缝里
lines.en: We hang together in the same crevice.
Our feelers touch once.
A wall only goes one way.
Up. Always up.
There's more moss and water up there.
We wait there for the rains.
The quiet of the wall is enough.
One forelimb pins it down.
Brought to my mouth, I taste it.
Too dry. I spit it out.
A sucker holds it fast.
I wedge it into a crevice.
Not enough to eat.
The wind nearly took it.
My tail curls around it.
Save it. Look later.
What grows on rock is more filling.
You stopped below.
I start working my way down.
Six legs turn a new direction.
Every feeler points at you.
The rock face is loose here.
I pick a steadier route.
Standing still. Convenient.
I flatten and pick up speed.
Gravel begins to fall.
Consider that a notice.
I descend in a spiral on the wall.
You aren't watching above.

lines.zh: 我每条腿都找得到支点
lines.en: Every leg finds a hold.
This wall is simple for me.
Half the height left.
You hear stone rattling.
I pause half a breath, then move.
You turned. I wait.
The scales on my back flare open.
Landing takes one motion.
I spring off the wall.
All six legs clamp onto you.
My suckers stick to your armor.
Forelimbs grab, hind limbs press.
That grip didn't hold.

lines.zh: 我的鳍像手，抓得住石壁。
lines.en: My fins are like hands and grip the stone.
My claws rake your shoulder.
You throw me off.
I land splayed on six legs.
On the ground I'm much slower.
Something moves on the rock face.
Six legs unfold at once.
I sweep the air with a feeler.
No high walls here.

lines.zh: 我爬上最近的一块石头
lines.en: I climb the nearest boulder.
The wind is dry. I'm not used to it.
My suckers seal to the stone.
I'm looking for water and moss.
More open than I expected.
I flatten and look upward.
Fire makes my suckers let go.

lines.zh: 落地的冲击传遍六条腿
lines.en: The landing shock runs through all six legs.
In water my suckers only clamp tighter.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从壁上撕下来
lines.en: The blast peels me off the wall.
Something sticks in my back.
This force makes my grip fail.
Hunger softens all six legs.

lines.zh: 雷打得我贴在壁上不敢动
lines.en: Lightning freezes me against the wall.
There is no wall anymore.
